quests.title: The Man Who Wouldn't Stay Down
quests.summary: A brawler banned years ago is back in the ring, glowing violet and refusing to fall.

brief.text: You're with the Patrol? Good. There's a fighter in the preliminaries nobody signed in. Big guy, bald, a scar on his forehead where a mark used to be.
The referee says he was banned for nearly killing a girl in the ring. Now he's back, and he glows. I saw him snap his own neck back into place.
And you didn't stop him?
I wanted to. But if I get disqualified I lose the prize money, and my village needs it. You're not entered. You can't be disqualified.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: World Tournament Stage. The crowd has gone very quiet.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Videl... where's Videl? I wasn't finished with her...

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: The tournament's over for you. Step off the stage.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Master Babidi gave me power. Now the voice gives me MORE. It says nobody remembers me. It says make them remember!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Spopovich's neck cracks sideways, then snaps back. He grins.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ghh... the voice... it's gone quiet. It was so loud.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It came up from below. From the place where they wash us. It smelled like wet ash. Like black water.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Who was talking to you?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Something little. It sounded little. And so, so patient.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Spopovich slumps. For the first time in decades, he looks embarrassed.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Hah! Hahaha! Even the new ones break! Videl! Come out and watch!

after.text: Thanks. I'll pay you back as soon as I win something, honest. Mr Goku says I've got a lot of something in me. I'm still figuring out what.

quests.title: The Champion Means It This Time
quests.summary: Mr Satan has finally become as strong as he always claimed. That is the problem.

brief.text: Something's wrong with Mr Satan. This morning he challenged the whole audience to fight him. All at the same time.
And he won. He flicked a grown man into the stands. Mr Satan doesn't do that. Mr Satan does the fake stomachache.
So the Malice gave him real power.
It gave him what he always said he had. Please be gentle. He paid for the hospital in my village.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Ah-ha-ha-ha! A challenger! Let the record show I gave you the chance to run!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Mr Satan, listen. That glow isn't you. Something's using you.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Using me? Nonsense! For the first time in my life my muscles do what I tell everyone they do! It's WONDERFUL!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Dynamite... Kick! No, wait, I mean it this time! DYNAMITE KICK!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The kick lands. The stage splits in two. Mr Satan stares down at his own foot in pure terror.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Oof! Ow! Ow ow ow. Oh no. Oh, my back. It's all gone, isn't it?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...You know, I let you win. A champion has to give the young ones hope. Write that down. Somebody write that down!

win.speaker: player
win.text: Sure. What did the voice promise you?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: That I'd never have to pretend again. Heh. That was a dirty trick, kid. A real dirty trick.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: The champ is undefeated! And this time it's even true! HA HA HA!

after.text: He's signing autographs with an ice pack on his head. He told a reporter he 'tested the rookie'. I think he's fine. Thank you, {name}.

quests.title: The Demon King Smells a Soul
quests.summary: A horned man in the stands has been watching Uub, and promises his master will collect him.

brief.text: A man with horns sat in the stands today. He didn't watch the fights. He watched me.
He said, 'Well, well, you've grown since you were pink.' I've never been pink, {name}. What does that even mean?
Did he say anything else?
That his master would come to collect me. Then he spat, and the ground turned to stone. He's waiting on the stage. At sunset.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: World Tournament Stage, sunset. A patch of the stage has been turned to grey stone.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: You are not the boy. Pity. I was told the boy would come, and that I would drag him down by the ankle.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Told by who?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I was in Paradise, you know. Paradise! Picking flowers. Singing hymns. And then the black tide rose and remembered me.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The Demon Realm has its legends, little patrol. One of them was meant to stay in a place with no exits. Now. Shall we?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Hah... It peels away like a scab. Disgusting. And I was so well liked in Paradise.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Listen. There is a clan from the Makyo Star whose children wear capes and dream of forever. One of them once wished for it.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: And the boy. Babidi wants the boy. Or rather, the pink thing the boy's soul used to be. Guard him.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Babidi's dead.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: So am I. Look how much that's stopped me.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Kneel. In the Demon Realm, losers carry the winner's throne. I'll find you a nice heavy one.

after.text: Babidi... Mr Buu hides under the table when he hears that name. I'm going to train harder. Whatever's coming, I won't be the one who brings it.

quests.title: The Soul He Used to Be
quests.summary: Uub dreams of being small, pink and laughing while a planet breaks. A wizard is calling him home.

brief.text: {name}, I need to ask something strange. I keep dreaming I'm small and pink, laughing while a planet breaks. Every night it's louder.
And there's a voice in the dream. 'Papparapa.' Over and over. Mr Buu heard me say it and hid in the fridge.
If I go wrong... if I start laughing like that... stop me. Don't hold back because I'm a kid. Promise me.
I promise. And then we find whoever's saying papparapa.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The tournament stage at night. Uub stands in the middle of it, giggling in a voice that is not his.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hee hee hee! Uub is sleeping. Uub is little. I remember being big. I remember EVERYTHING.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Uub! Buu know that laugh! That bad Buu! Bad bad bad!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Papparapa! The Malice is a marvelous thing. It doesn't even need my magic. It only needs a past, and this boy has a delicious one!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: So that's how it works. It digs up what you were.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Clever! But you have no past at all, do you? How very rude. Uub, my pet, break this one first!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: No, no, NO! My Buu! The voice promised me my Buu back! It promised me the boy!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...I'm me. I'm just me. {name}, I think I was dreaming his dream.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Uub! Buu and Uub same-same inside! Buu help. Buu hold the bad part so Uub not have to.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Buu lays a hand on Uub's head. Their ki flows together, pink and bright, and nothing violet survives it.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It's quiet. It's really quiet. Thank you, Mr Buu. Thank you, {name}. Now train with me. Properly.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Papparapa! Two Majins for the price of one wizard! Oh, I'm brilliant!

after.text: Mr Buu says I can borrow his power when I need it. I'll be careful with it. I owe you a real fight, {name}. Come find me when you're ready.

quests.title: My Brother Laughed
quests.summary: Android 17 hasn't answered his sister in days. The one time he did, he laughed.

brief.text: I don't do favors. So think of this as a job. My brother's out on one of the islands and he's not answering.
He answered once. He said the island was 'finally quiet' and laughed. 17 doesn't laugh. He smirks. There's a difference.
Is he dangerous?
He's always dangerous. Now he's also sloppy. Krillin wanted to come. I locked him in the bathroom. Don't tell Marron.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Islands. The birds have gone. The poachers' boats are burning in the bay.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Oh, the Patrol. Did my sister send you? That's sweet. She always sends someone else.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: She's worried. She says you laughed.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I used to guard this place from poachers. Then something whispered that poachers were never the problem. People are. All of them.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Don't worry. I'll make it quick. I'm very efficient.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...Tch. That's annoying. It was rewriting my priorities, the way Gero used to.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It came in at the shoreline. Thin purple cracks in the air, right at the waterline. Like something leaking up from under the world.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Your sister's waiting.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Tell her I'm fine. No. Tell her I said thanks. She'll hate that more.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: You lasted longer than the poachers. That's not a compliment.

after.text: He said thanks? ...Gross. Here, this is yours. And {name}, if anyone asks, I wasn't worried.

quests.title: The Off Switch Job
quests.summary: A heist in Dr. Gero's old lab: grab the remote that can shut down 17 and 18. And the gold.

brief.text: New job. Gero had a lab under the northern mountains. Bulma says there's a remote in there that can shut 17 and me off. Permanently.
Someone's been digging there. Something round and white that hums to itself. If the Malice gets that remote, it gets us.
So we break in and grab it.
We break in, grab it, and grab the gold bars Gero hid in the back wall. I counted them once while he slept. Call it back pay.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Dr. Gero's abandoned laboratory. The steel door has been melted from the inside.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Intruders. Identified: Android 18, defective. Unknown subject: no data. Absorbing.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: 19. You were scrap last time I checked. Who put you back together?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I was reassembled by the dark. It pays in power. It requests the controller. It requests that you stop moving.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: We'll take the remote. You can keep the dark.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Energy... draining... I was only following... the new program...

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Program said... 'collect the off switches of the strong... the little master wants obedient toys'...

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Little master. That's the second time I've heard 'little'. Grab the remote, {name}. I'll grab the gold.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: 18 crushes the remote in one hand, then pockets three gold bars without a word.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Energy absorbed. Unknown subject tasted of... nothing. Nothing at all.

after.text: Remote's dust. Gold's split. Don't look at me like that, you got the bigger half. Krillin can't know where it came from.

quests.title: Gone to See Dad
quests.summary: Android 17 has been lured into Hell, where Dr. Gero has built a second 17 and wants them to merge.

brief.text: 17 vanished again. This time he left a note: 'Gone to see Dad.' 17 doesn't have a dad. He has a guy who cut him open.
Gero's in Hell, and with Garlic Jr. running things down there, Gero's found friends. He built another 17. A copy. He wants them to merge.
Then we go to Hell and pull your brother out.
I'm coming. Don't argue. I'm the only one who knows where Gero keeps his own off switch. Hint: it's his face.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hell. A workshop of stolen pipes, bolted to the Soul Cleansing Machine's overflow.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Ah, 18! You came home. And you brought the anomaly. Garlic Jr. offered a splendid price for it.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Where's my brother, old man?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Improved. Garlic Jr.'s Mist did what my circuits never could. It made him want to obey. Meet the new 17!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Sister. You look weak. You married weak. Merge with me and stop being weak.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: ...18? Why do I have two sets of memories? One of them was in a jar.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Because the jar guy built a copy of you. You ate it. It's fine. You've done worse.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: My masterpiece! Garlic Jr. will have my head for this!

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Get in line.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: 18 drags her brother up out of Hell by the collar. He doesn't resist. He might even be smiling.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Two androids and the anomaly. Gero, tell the little emperor his order is ready.

after.text: He's back on the islands being smug. Fine. I'll train you, {name}. Don't make it weird. And don't get used to me using your name.

quests.title: The Swordsman Who Lost Everything
quests.summary: A swordsman haunts the ruins wearing Trunks' jacket. He is Trunks, from a future where nobody came back.

brief.text: You must be the recruit. I'm Trunks. I'm from a future that... isn't anymore. It's a long story.
There's a swordsman in these ruins wearing my jacket and carrying my sword. Mine's on my back. He's me, {name}. A me where nobody came back.
An echo. The Kais say the Malice drags them across time.
Then I can't fight him. I'd hesitate, and he wouldn't. Please. Try not to let him tell you too much about where he came from.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Another recruit. In my timeline they all died the first week.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Trunks says you're him.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I'm what he'd be if the androids had won one more year. Gohan's grave is under a parking lot where I come from. I can't even find which one.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The voice says I can save it all, if I just stop caring who gets cut. It's a good offer. Draw.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...My hands. They're shaking. They never shook when I fought. Maybe that was the problem.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Tell him not to lose Gohan. Tell him... no. He already did. Tell him to keep the sword sharp anyway.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The echo thins like smoke. The sword stays behind, buried in the asphalt, humming.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Too slow. Everyone here is always too slow.

after.text: He left the sword. It's exactly like mine, down to the notch. I'll teach you to use it, {name}. Someone should learn it from a me who still has hope.

quests.title: The Last Lesson
quests.summary: A one-armed man glows violet in the rain. He taught Trunks everything, and he has been dead for years.

brief.text: {name}. Last night I felt a ki I haven't felt in years. Warm, stubborn, a little sad. It's Gohan. My Gohan. The one who taught me.
He died a long time ago. The Malice must have pulled his echo out of my timeline. He's missing an arm, and he's glowing.
Do you want me to go alone?
No. I have to see him. But I don't think I can raise a hand to him. If I freeze, you keep going. That's what he'd tell you to do.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: City Ruins, night. Rain on broken glass. A one-armed man stands where a bakery used to be.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Trunks. You got tall. I'm sorry. I don't think I can stop myself from hurting you.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Gohan... please. Fight it. You always told me to fight.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I'm trying. It found the part of me that watched everyone die and couldn't stop it. It says that part was right all along.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: So this time I'll do it properly. No mercy for the androids. No mercy for anyone too weak to stop them.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Ah. There's the rain. I couldn't feel the rain while it had me.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Trunks. Don't live in the past for my sake. The Malice lives there. It feeds there. Stay where you are.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: I don't want to lose you again.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: I know. But you have a new partner. Look after {name}. That's my last lesson, all right? It's a good one.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: He ruffles Trunks' hair with his one hand, the way he used to. Then there is only the rain.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Stay down, Trunks. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.

after.text: He taught me everything, and I couldn't even lift my sword. Thank you for doing what I couldn't. I'm going to practice. A lot.

quests.title: Something Wants My Time Machine
quests.summary: Empty clothes on the road and nothing else. Imperfect Cell's echo is hunting a ride through time.

brief.text: Something's stalking my time machine. It left an empty set of clothes on the road and nothing else. I know that trick.
Cell. Not the perfect one, the larva. In another timeline he killed me for this machine. Now his echo wants it again.
What happens if he gets it?
He could ride the Malice to any era he likes and eat everyone before they're strong. I'll guard the machine. You hunt him.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Mmm. You smell of nothing. No history, no ancestors, no cells I recognize. You're a blank page.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: And you're a bug looking for a ride.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Crude. I prefer 'connoisseur'. The voice has promised me every timeline as a buffet. I'll start with yours.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Cell's tail flicks toward a crowd of fleeing survivors. When the dust settles, he is taller.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Ahh. Much better. Shall we discuss the menu?

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Grr... the voice is gone. It spoke like a petty little tyrant. I despise petty tyrants. I prefer being one.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: A gift, blank page. It promised me the machine if I collected strong hearts for it. For someone who intends to live forever.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Who?

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: It never said. But it laughed like a child who has never once been told no.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: A blank page... I wonder what I'll become when I absorb nothing.

after.text: The machine's safe. I used to dream about killing him myself. Now I just feel tired. Let's both get stronger, {name}.

quests.title: Hope Has a Breaking Point
quests.summary: Trunks has made a list of tyrants to kill as children. It's in his own handwriting.

brief.text: {name}. Listen and don't interrupt. Since Gohan's echo I keep having one thought. Go back. Kill Gero before he builds them. Kill Cell in his jar.
Then kill Frieza as a child. Kill every tyrant as a child. It sounds so reasonable. That's how I know it isn't mine.
The Malice is in you.
It's been in me since the swordsman. Meet me in the ruins at nightfall. If I'm glowing, don't talk. Just win.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Ruined Earth. Trunks waits on a shattered overpass, his hair burning gold and violet.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: You came. I knew you would. You're reliable, {name}. That's why I need you out of the way.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You told me not to talk.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Then let me. I've fixed it. One trip back. A few small graves, and every future is saved. Gohan keeps his arm. Mother keeps her smile.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Anyone who stands in the way of that future isn't my friend. They're the androids.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ugh... I'd have killed children. I had a list. It was in my handwriting.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It kept saying 'a pure world, forever, without the weak'. Over and over. Someone out there truly believes that.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Then we beat that someone. Your way. The hopeful way.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...Gohan would have liked you. All right. No more running from my future. Let's take it back the right way.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: I'm sorry. I'll come back for you once the timeline's fixed. You won't even remember this.

after.text: I burned the list. I'll be your master, if you'll still have me. I know what it looks like when hope breaks. Let me show you how to hold it together.

quests.title: The Birds Stopped Singing
quests.summary: Every bird has fled the glacier. Another of Gero's machines is humming a cowboy tune in the ice.

brief.text: The birds have left the glacier. All of them. Even the ones that never leave.
Another of Gero's machines is here. Android 13. I was built to recognize my brothers. He hums a tune and fires at seals for sport.
Why not stop him yourself?
I do not want to fight. And something in me wants to, too much. Please go. I will keep the chicks warm until you return.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Glacier. A trucker cap lies on the ice. Then a man under it sits up.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Well, lookee here. Gero's list said 'kill Son Goku'. The new voice says 'kill whoever's got no history'. Guess that's you, partner.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You talk like a cowboy.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Gero had his hobbies. Now quit jawin'. 14 and 15 left me their spare chips in a box. Real thoughtful of 'em.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Two red chips flare in 13's chest. His body swells, blue and roaring.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: S.S. DEADLY BOMBER, comin' right up!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Aw, heck. Busted back down to factory settings.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: That voice? Wasn't Gero. It was colder. Like a fella who's sat in the dark so long he forgot how to blink.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Where did it come from?

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Under the ice. Cracks in the air, purple as a bruise. Tell old Sixteen I'm sorry about the birds.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Yeehaw! One less nobody. Gero'd be proud. Well. Gero'd be grumpy. Same thing with him.

after.text: A gull returned this morning. Only one. It is enough for today. Thank you, {name}.

quests.title: Gero's Last Order
quests.summary: Android 16's oldest command has woken up: kill Son Goku. He has asked you to stop him.

brief.text: {name}. The order Gero gave me has woken up. 'Kill Son Goku.' I have never wanted to obey it. Today I want to.
The Malice found the order the way water finds a crack. It is very patient with me. It speaks of a world where I never have to choose.
What do you need?
Fight me before it finishes. Do not let me reach Mount Paozu. And if I reach for my self-destruct device, run very far. Please.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Glacier. Android 16 stands in a flock of birds that will not leave his shoulders.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Go. All of you. Go now.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The birds scatter. Violet light bleeds through the seams of his armor.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Target: Son Goku. Obstacle: {name}. I am... sorry. Engaging.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: It says nature is weak. It says the weak should be erased. I loved the weak things. I still... do.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: System clear. The order is gone. Not suppressed. Gone.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: At the end it reached for the self-destruct. It found the bomb was removed long ago. Bulma was kind to me.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Then you get to stay.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Yes. I get to stay. I did not know I wanted that until now.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: One by one, the birds come back.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Obstacle removed. Proceeding to Mount Paozu. Please... someone... stop me.

after.text: I will teach you, {name}. My techniques are heavy and hard. But I will teach you to use them so that small things can live.

quests.title: The Tree That Ate the Snow
quests.summary: A giant tree grew beside Muscle Tower overnight. Its fruit is purple, and a pirate is eating it.

brief.text: Hello. I am Hatchan. Goku calls me Eighter. Please, can you help? A tree grew next to the tower. Very big. In one night.
The snow is going away. The rabbits are very thin. The tree has purple fruit. A man is eating the fruit and laughing.
Did he hurt you?
He said I was junk. It is okay. I am a little bit junk. But the rabbits are not junk.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Another bug crawling up my tree. You know what this fruit is? Power. Sweet, pure power, sucked straight out of the planet.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: And now it's purple.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Someone down in the dark watered it for me. Said the Tree of Might could feed his army. Fine by me. I eat first.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Turles bites into a violet fruit. His eyes roll back. Fur bursts from his arms.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: GRRRAAAAAHHH!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Tch... the fruit was rotten. Rotten from the start. He gave me a poisoned seed, the sneaky runt.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: He wanted his trees all over this planet. Feed the strong, starve the rest, then take the strong. I'd almost respect it.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Who is he?

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Never gave a name. Just a shadow and a smell of swamp water. Now get lost before I change my mind about losing.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Heh. Fertilizer. The tree thanks you.

after.text: The tree is falling down. The snow is coming back. Thank you. I will knit you a scarf. It will be very big.

quests.title: The Star That Calls to Machines
quests.summary: A metal planet is whispering to Hatchan through his bolts. It wants every machine on Earth. Him first.

brief.text: There is a new star in the sky. It is not a star. It is metal. At night it talks to me through my bolts.
It says, 'Come home, machine. Join the Star.' I do not want to. But my feet walked to the window by themselves.
Then we break the star before it calls you again.
Please be careful. It says it has many bodies. It says it learns from every punch.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Outer Space. A metal planet, the Big Gete Star, crawls toward Earth like a spider made of cables.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Organic. No. Something else. Your ki has no point of origin. The Star cannot calculate you. Irritating.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Cooler, right? I heard you were scrap.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I am the Star's will, and the Star has a new partner. He wants every machine on Earth. Starting with that sad green giant.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Analysis complete. Adjusting.

intro.speaker: enemy3
intro.text: We are many. You are one. The math is simple.

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: Systems... corrupted... no. Systems... clean? The Star is dying.

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: I remember now. My brother's killer is out there, and I let a voice in the dark make me its delivery service. Unforgivable.

win.speaker: player
win.text: What did he want with the machines?

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: Bodies that never age. Soldiers that never tire. He thinks like a tyrant with all of eternity and nothing to fill it.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Assimilated. Hatchan, come home. Your friend is already part of the Star.

after.text: The voice stopped. My feet are my feet again. You are a good friend, {name}. I will tell Goku.

quests.title: A Brain Wants Your Body
quests.summary: A brain in a glass dome has been asking Hatchan where you sleep. It wants to wear you.

brief.text: {name}. A big robot came to the tower. On top was a glass ball. Inside the ball was a brain. It was looking at me.
The brain asked about you. Where you train. What you eat. It said, 'The empty one. The vessel with no past. I must have it.'
He wants my body?
He said, 'The Malice cannot hold it, but I can wear it.' I do not like that sentence. He went to the ice.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Glacier. A steel fortress juts out of the ice, steaming.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: At last! The specimen! Do you know how long I have waited in this jar for a body worth having?

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Dr. Wheelo. I've read about you. You froze to death.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Frozen, not finished! My partner in the dark promised me the strongest body in the world. Then he admitted he could not touch yours.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: A body with no past and my brain inside it. I would be the first truly new being in history!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: My dome is cracked... my dream is cracked...

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Fine. Fine! But understand, specimen: he fears you. My partner. The little one with the star. He cannot read you, and it terrifies him.

win.speaker: player
win.text: The little one with the star?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Look up at night. You will see it. A red star that should not be there.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Excellent! Prepare the transplant! Careful with the skull, it's mine now!

after.text: There is a red star in the sky. I do not like it. I will stand on the tower and watch it for you, {name}.

quests.title: Justice Never Naps
quests.summary: Two very short masked villains have seized the King's Castle and locked the King in a cupboard.

brief.text: Halt, citizen! Ah, you're the new Patrol hero! I am the Great Saiyaman, defender of justice, and I need backup. Urgently. Ahem. Heroically.
Two masked villains have taken the King's Castle. They ate the royal banquet, drew mustaches on the portraits, and locked the King in a cupboard.
Masked villains. Short ones?
...Very short. They may be my little brother and his friend. They may also be glowing purple. Please don't tell my mother either way.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: King's Castle. Somebody has written 'TRUNKS AND GOTEN RULE' across the throne in ketchup.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hey Trunks, it's the Patrol! My big brother sent a babysitter!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Heh, perfect. The voice said grown-ups are boring and we should be in charge of everything forever. Starting with this castle!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Forever is a long time to skip bedtime.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: No bedtime EVER! Super Saiyan, go!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ow... Trunks, I feel weird. Like when you eat too much cake and then remember you did something bad.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: ...We locked the King in a cupboard. He's a dog. He was crying. Oh man, my mom's going to kill me.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: The voice sounded like a kid, but old. Like a grandpa doing a kid voice. It was creepy, okay?

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Ha! Grown-ups lose! Goten, grab the King's crown, it's ours now!

after.text: Justice is served! And so is dessert, since the boys must now wash every plate in the castle. You were magnificent, partner! Strike a pose with me!

quests.title: Great Saiyaman 2 Strikes Back
quests.summary: A second Great Saiyaman has challenged you for the job of Saiyaman's partner. She does the poses better.

brief.text: Partner! Terrible news! A second Great Saiyaman has appeared! She's stealing my poses! And she does them better!
She left a letter: 'To the rookie. If you're going to fight beside my Saiyaman, you fight me first. Castle roof. Signed, Great Saiyaman 2.'
Your Saiyaman?
I have no idea who she could possibly be. None at all. She sounds a lot like Videl. Which is a coincidence.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: King's Castle. A caped figure in a helmet lands on the battlements and strikes an excellent pose.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I am the Great Saiyaman 2! Justice incarnate! Also the one who sewed his cape, so watch it!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Videl, everyone at the Lookout knows it's you.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Shh! Rule one of heroics: never say the name! Rule two: if you're going to watch his back out there, I need to know you can take a hit.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: No Malice here. Just me, annoyed. Let's go!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Okay. Okay! You're good. Better than good. Fine, you can be his partner. Second partner. I'm first.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Real talk, {name}. The Malice keeps going after people we love. If it ever goes after him, you call me. Not the Kais. Me.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Deal.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Good. Now help me fix this cape. I tore it on the roof.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Justice prevails! Sorry! Come back when you've trained. And bring snacks, Saiyaman always forgets the snacks.

after.text: She says you passed! She also says I'm doing the third pose wrong. I'm not! ...Am I?

quests.title: Emperor Gotenks Doesn't Share
quests.summary: Goten and Trunks fused to help the Patrol. The fusion won, then lost, then crowned itself emperor.

brief.text: Partner! The boys wanted to make up for the castle, so they fused to help the Patrol. Gotenks went off to fight the Malice all by himself.
He won! Then he lost. Then he came back glowing and renamed himself Grand Supreme Emperor Gotenks of the Universe. He's taken over the Time Chamber.
How bad is it?
He's charging admission. And he has an attack called the Charging Ultra Buu Buu Volleyball. I don't know what it does. I'm afraid to find out.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hyperbolic Time Chamber. A hand-painted sign reads: EMPEROR GOTENKS. NO GROWN-UPS. NO ROOKIES. NO BEDTIME.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Behold! The grim reaper of justice, now with forty percent more evil! The voice made me even more awesome. I didn't think that was possible!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You know you split up in thirty minutes, right?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The voice says if I let it in, I never have to split! Gotenks forever! No more sharing a brain with a crybaby!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Super Saiyan... THREE! Behold my glorious hairdo!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Aw, man. That was so uncool of me.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: With a pop, Gotenks splits back into two very sheepish boys.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Goten says sorry. Trunks says it was Goten's idea. They both admit the voice said it was once the smallest in its family too.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Galactic Donut! Ha, now you're wearing a ring of shame! Gotenks is champion forever!

after.text: The boys are grounded until next Tuesday! I may also have been grounded. Videl was very clear. Thank you, partner!

quests.title: The Monster Wearing Our Voices
quests.summary: An echo of Super Buu crawls out of a rift above the Lookout, still speaking with the voices it ate.

brief.text: {name}. No poses this time. Something came out of a rift above the Lookout. Pink. Smiling. It's using Gotenks' voice. And mine.
It's an echo of Super Buu, from the day he absorbed the boys, and then me. Garlic Jr. must have dug it out of Hell's overflow just to break us.
Then let's break it first.
Together. And afterwards I'd like to train you. Not as the Great Saiyaman. Well. Also as the Great Saiyaman. The costume helps me focus.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Kami's Lookout. A pink giant stands on the tiles, wearing a purple vest that belongs to a child.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hee hee! Look, it's Gohan! Gotenks says hi! Gotenks says you were too slow to save him!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Leave them out of this. Their voices don't belong to you.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: They belong to the little emperor now. Garlic Jr. says anything that's eaten stays eaten. Forever and ever!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: And then I ate you. Remember, Gohan? You were so strong. And so delicious.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Nnngh... no... want to stay... want to keep...

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The echo comes apart in pink threads. Two small voices and one older one drift free and fade.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: That's all it was. Old fear wearing a mask. I've had enough masks for a while. Ironically.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Garlic Jr. knows exactly where we're weakest. So we get stronger there. Ready, partner?

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Yum! Gotenks, Gohan, and the empty one! Garlic Jr. will be so jealous!

after.text: I'll be at the castle. The King says I can use the courtyard for training. He also asks that I stop posing on his balcony.

quests.title: Cell Juniors Are Not Cute
quests.summary: Little blue squatters have taken the Cell Games Arena. They glow, they giggle, and they throw rocks.

brief.text: Hey! You're the Patrol rookie, right? I'm Pan. Grandpa Satan says this arena is his. Grandpa Goku says it's where Uncle Gohan got awesome. So it's mine.
And some little blue creeps are squatting in it. They glow purple and keep saying 'play with us'. One threw a rock at my head!
Cell Juniors. They were born here.
I don't care where they were born, I'm kicking them out. You can come. If you can keep up!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Cell Games Arena. Three small blue figures hop across the ring, giggling.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Play! Play! Papa says to play rough!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Your papa is a big green bug who lost to my uncle. Get out of my arena!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Not Papa Cell. New Papa. Dark Papa. He says the arena is a doorway.

intro.speaker: enemy3
intro.text: Get the girl first! Then the empty one!

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: Owie... the bad feeling's gone... we only wanted to play...

win.speaker: player2
win.text: ...Okay, that's a little bit cute. A little bit.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: The doorway is under the ring. It smells like the bottom of the world. Don't go down there. Promise?

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: We won! We won! New Papa will give us candy made of screams!

after.text: Not bad, rookie! Next time I'm doing the cool finishing move, though. You're on my team now. That's not a question.

quests.title: Grandpa Got Small
quests.summary: Goku was turned into a kid by the dragon balls. Now he won't stop fighting, or eating, or saying sorry.

brief.text: Rookie. Grandpa Goku's being weird. You know the dragon balls turned him into a kid? He thinks it's hilarious.
But yesterday he wouldn't stop sparring. Eleven hours. He broke my arm guard and didn't even say sorry. Grandpa ALWAYS says sorry.
Is he glowing?
Only a little. Only when he smiles. And he smiles like he never wants to stop fighting. I can't beat him alone. Please.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Mount Paozu. A small boy with wild hair floats above the trees. A violet glow flickers along his tail.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hey, Pan! You brought a friend! Awesome! I've been waiting for somebody new to fight!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Grandpa, stop it. You're scaring me. You haven't eaten in two days.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Who needs to eat? The voice says if I let it in, I can fight forever. Forever, Pan! Strong guys forever and ever!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Super Saiyan 3! C'mon, {name}, show me what you've got!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Whoa... ow. Huh. Pan, why are you crying?

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Because you broke my arm guard and didn't say sorry! Dummy!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...Oh. Sorry, Pan. I'm really sorry. I didn't like that voice. It made fighting feel like eating when you're not even hungry.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Hey, {name}, I've got one more form. Red fur and everything. Let's train sometime. Normal fighting. The fun kind.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Aw, done already? Get up, get up! Let's go again! And again!

after.text: He ate four bowls of rice and fell asleep standing up. He's back. Thanks, rookie. I owe you one. Don't tell anyone I cried.

quests.title: Baby Steps
quests.summary: Vegeta has white hair, a red mark and a Tuffle grudge. A parasite named Baby wants a moon tonight.

brief.text: Rookie, it's bad. Vegeta's walking around with white hair and a red thing on his face. He called me 'Saiyan scum'. He always does, but this time he meant it.
Bulma says there's a parasite in him. Baby. He's a Tuffle, the people the Saiyans wiped out. And the Malice loves him. All that revenge.
Possession inside possession. Lovely.
He's making a fake moon tonight to turn into a giant golden ape. We're going. I'm a quarter Saiyan, I can take a quarter of him.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Wasteland, night. A false moon of blue light hangs over the rocks.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The Saiyan girl. And the anomaly. Delightful. Monkeys like your family wiped out the Tuffles. I have waited a very long time.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Get out of Vegeta! He's a jerk, but he's OUR jerk!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The Malice and I want the same thing: a universe that remembers every wrong ever done to it. It feeds me grudges. I have so many.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Look at the moon, little Saiyan. Look at what your blood becomes.

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: No... Tuffle... revenge... it was so close...

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: A tiny silver shape crawls out of Vegeta's mouth and sizzles on the rocks. The Malice tears out of it with a shriek.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Ew! Ew ew ew! Okay, he's out. Vegeta, are you okay?

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Vegeta mutters something about killing everyone involved, then passes out. He'll be fine.

lose.speaker: enemy3
lose.text: Saiyans bow to the Tuffle king! Kneel, all of you, kneel forever!

after.text: Vegeta's pretending it never happened. Bulma's pretending to believe him. And Baby's in a jar now. He keeps asking for a mirror. Creepy.

quests.title: Every Wish Leaves Dirt
quests.summary: The dragon balls are cracking. Every selfish wish ever made is waking up as a Shadow Dragon.

brief.text: Rookie. Grandpa Goku says the dragon balls are cracking. Every wish leaves a little dirt behind, and now the dirt is waking up as dragons.
And Garlic Jr. wished on them once, right? For immortality. Grandpa thinks the Malice eats wish-dirt too, like the dirt from the soul machine.
Same disease, different organ.
Gross, but yes. Grandpa's taking care of four of the Shadow Dragons. We get the rest. The One-Star is the worst. Ready?

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Desert. Three shadows coil above the dunes, each wearing a dragon ball like a jewel.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Forgive me, young warriors. I am Nuova, of the Four-Star Ball. I would face you honorably, but something has its claws in my pride.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Then we'll beat it out of you! Honorably!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: How quaint. I am Syn. I remember every selfish wish your kind ever made. The little emperor's wish tasted best of all.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Beat us, and I will take the other balls and become Omega. Garlic Jr. wanted a dragon of his own. He will have one.

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: Impossible... minus energy... cannot be... cleansed...

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It can, Syn. By someone with no wish to their name. {name} has never asked us for anything. That is why we could not hold them.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Did you hear that, rookie? You're like the only person in the universe who never wished for anything! That's kind of awesome.

win.speaker: player
win.text: I just got here.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Exactly so. Go, both of you. Your Patrol is strongest when it fights for no reward. Well. Nearly no reward.

lose.speaker: enemy3
lose.text: Minus energy is endless. Wishes are endless. Despair is endless. Kneel.

after.text: I'm training you now, rookie. Properly. I'm Goku's granddaughter AND Mr Satan's granddaughter. That makes me half genius and half showbiz.

quests.title: A Crack in the Seal
quests.summary: A seal the Kais made ages ago has cracked. Seals don't crack on their own. Someone taught it how.

brief.text: {name}. Thank you for coming to the Sacred World. I have an unpleasant errand, and my Kibito half insists I stop doing everything myself.
Long ago the Kais sealed a band of space pirates, Bojack's Galaxy Soldiers, inside a star. The seal held for ages. Yesterday it cracked.
A seal does not crack by itself. Someone taught it how. And the first to slip through is Zangya, the cleverest of them.
Where is she now?
Here. In the garden, picking the sacred fruit and laughing. She is waiting for you, I think. That is what worries me.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: So you're the Patrol. You look like you got dressed in the dark. Cute, though.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: The seal. Who broke it?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Nobody broke it, sweetie. Someone whispered through it. A voice from a place even emptier than ours. He knew all about seals. He'd escaped one.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: He said, 'Make them burn, and I'll open the rest.' I do like a man with a plan.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ugh. My hair. Fine, you win. Don't gloat, it's unattractive.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: The voice? It was small and smug and it hated the Kais even more than we do. It called itself... no. Bojack would kill me. If he's out yet.

win.speaker: player
win.text: If?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Oh, sweetie. He's coming. The crack gets wider every day.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Aw. Don't cry. I'll tell Bojack you were brave. He won't care, but I'll tell him.

after.text: A voice that escaped a seal of its own. Very few beings have ever done that. I must consult the old records. Thank you, {name}.

quests.title: The Galaxy Soldier Waits
quests.summary: Bojack is free, waiting by the star that held him for the one who freed him. Nobody is coming.

brief.text: The records are clear. Only two beings have ever escaped a Kai seal. Bojack, now, and one other whose name has been scratched off the page. Deliberately.
Bojack waits at the edge of the galaxy by the star that held him, calling for the one who freed him.
Then let's be there when nobody answers.
Well put. I will hold the seal open behind him. You make sure he goes back into it unconscious. Gently, if possible. Firmly, if not.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Outer Space. A cracked star bleeds violet light. A blue-skinned giant drifts before it, arms folded.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: A Kai's errand runner. I spent an eternity inside that star, listening to it burn. Do you know what eternity sounds like?

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Bad, I'm guessing.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: It sounds like your own heartbeat, forever. The voice who freed me knows that sound too. He promised the Kais would hear it next.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Full power. Let's see if you're worth the wait.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Hah... Strong. Damn the Kais and damn you. Mostly the Kais.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: He never came. The voice. He swore he'd meet me here. He used me as a distraction, the little rat. Some emperor.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Emperor?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: That's what he calls himself. Emperor of a universe that doesn't exist yet. Ask your Kais who they lost track of.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Tell the Kais to start polishing a new star. They'll need one for themselves.

after.text: Bojack has agreed to stay on our world, under guard. He seems offended that his liberator abandoned him. I believe it is the most honest thing about him.

quests.title: The Flute Has Stopped
quests.summary: The Kais once sealed a boy hero in a music box for a thousand years. The box has opened, and his song is gone.

brief.text: {name}, I must confess something. The Kais once sealed a young hero, Tapion, inside a music box, with a monster sealed inside him. For a thousand years.
It was a terrible thing to ask of a boy. We told ourselves it was necessary. The box opened last night by itself. His flute has gone silent.
And the monster?
Hildegarn. Only Tapion's melody kept it asleep. The Malice has stuffed his flute with its own noise. Please. Help him play again.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: City Ruins, evening. A young swordsman lifts a cracked ocarina and plays notes that make no sound.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Stay back. I cannot hear my own song anymore. All I hear is a voice saying that a thousand years in a box is reason enough to hate the Kais.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Is it right?

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: ...Some days. Not today. Today I want to protect someone. Will you help me?

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hildegarn tears itself out of Tapion's shadow, a mountain of claws and violet fire.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: GROOOOOOHHH!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Grrrrrhh...

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The Malice boils off Hildegarn's hide. From somewhere, faintly, a melody begins.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: I can hear it. My song. Thank you, {name}. You fight like someone who has never been locked away.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Tell the Kai I forgive him. Not because he deserves it. Because I'm tired of carrying it, and the Malice loves what people carry.

lose.speaker: narrator
lose.text: Hildegarn's roar drowns out the last note of the flute.

after.text: He forgave us. I don't know what to do with that. My Kibito half says I should say thank you and stop fidgeting. Thank you, {name}.

quests.title: Two Plus Two Is Too Many
quests.summary: The fusions of Goku and Vegeta are over. Their Corrupted echoes are not, and they are arguing on the Kais' planet.

brief.text: {name}. A delicate matter, and one I am, ahem, uniquely qualified to explain. When two beings fuse, their hearts are poured into a single cup.
Goku and Vegeta fused to fight the overflow. Twice: once with Potara earrings, once with that dance. The fusions ended. Their echoes did not.
So there are two fused echoes of the strongest Saiyans. Both Corrupted.
And arguing over which one is stronger. On my planet. Using my mountains. Please stop them before they run out of mountains.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Supreme Kai's World. Half a mountain range is missing. Two figures hover over the crater, glaring at each other.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Finally, an audience. I'm Vegito. The Malice took Kakarot's hunger and Vegeta's pride and doubled them both. It's wonderful.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Wonderful? You're a pair of earrings with an ego. I'm Gogeta. I was made by a dance. A dance takes commitment.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Do you two want to fight me, or each other?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: We'll settle that after. You first. Don't worry, we'll be quick. He only has thirty minutes.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Hah... ha... the Malice is out. And the timer's up, I can feel it.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Same. Nice work, {name}. Kakarot says you're amazing. Vegeta says you were adequate. Trust me, that's the same compliment.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Two flashes of light. Four Saiyans for an instant, then two confused ones, then nothing but drifting dust and laughter.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Next. Is there anyone else in this universe? Bring us someone stronger.

after.text: Their echoes left their techniques behind, rather like a scent. I will help you learn them. And I will send Goku and Vegeta a bill for the mountains.

quests.title: Riot in the Waiting Line
quests.summary: The souls queued for the Soul Cleansing Machine have stopped waiting. A swordsman is leading the riot.

brief.text: You are the Kais' new fighter. I am Paikuhan. I keep order in this place when the ogres cannot. Lately, the ogres cannot.
The souls waiting for the Cleansing Machine have stopped waiting. One of Cooler's soldiers, Sauza, is leading a riot. He is skilled. He is also loud.
What started it?
Two nights ago I saw a small cloaked figure at the machine's intake. When I reached it, it was gone. In the morning the machine was weeping black water.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hell. A mob of glowing souls surges against the ogres' barricades. At its head stands a blue-skinned swordsman.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Brothers! The machine wants to scrub us clean! Wipe away everything we were! I say we keep it! I say we keep ALL of it!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You're dead, Sauza. You don't get to keep anything.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Says the fresh face. You can't even feel it, can you? The filth is power down here now. Someone left the tap running.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Salza Blade! Let's see how you look in pieces!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Hgh... it's leaving. Sliding back down the pipes. Like it has somewhere better to be.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Lord Cooler's down here somewhere. If that stuff found me, it found him. And he holds a grudge like nobody else.

win.speaker: player
win.text: We'll find him.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Find him before he finds you, rookie. That's my only advice. No, wait. Also: watch the pipes.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: One less Patrol! Brothers, march on the machine! Nobody gets cleansed today!

after.text: Sauza is calm. The line moves again. But the machine still weeps. Come back, {name}. This was only the first wave.

quests.title: The Other Brother
quests.summary: Frieza's elder brother has carved an empire out of a corner of Hell, and he wants to meet you.

brief.text: Cooler. Frieza's elder brother. Sauza was right. He has taken a corner of Hell for himself and declared it an empire.
He has the Malice in him, but he wears it like a cloak, not a chain. He is too proud to be its slave. That makes him worse.
Worse how?
A slave fights because it must. Cooler fights because he enjoys it. And he has heard about you. He wants to meet the one the Malice cannot touch.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: So you're the curiosity. The one the darkness can't swallow. You look so ordinary. How disappointing.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You're not Frieza. I'll assume you're more polite.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Don't compare me to my brother. Frieza was given everything and lost it to a monkey. I earned everything, then lost to the same monkey. Hence my mood.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Let me show you a form my brother never had.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Hmph. The violet stuff is gone. A pity. It gave me such lovely ideas.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: It rises from below the machine. A deep, wet, ancient cold. It has a master, child, and the master is not as clever as he thinks.

win.speaker: player
win.text: You sound sure.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: I was an emperor. I know a crown that wears its king when I see one.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Ordinary to the end. Sauza, have this cleaned up.

after.text: Cooler has withdrawn to his corner to sulk. That is the best outcome I hoped for. You fight with your whole heart, {name}. I like that.

quests.title: The Old Namekian's Hands
quests.summary: Lord Slug has crawled out of Hell through a rift. The Malice has promised him youth, and he believes it.

brief.text: A prisoner has escaped Hell. Lord Slug, the old Namekian who once tried to freeze the Earth into a spaceship. He crawled up a rift to the surface.
He is very old and very afraid of being old. The Malice has promised him youth. He believes it. That is the saddest kind of fool.
Are you coming?
I am. A warrior of the Otherworld should bring back what escaped it. And I would like to see you fight up close.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Rocky Area, night. An ancient Namekian in a cracked helmet stands at the lip of a violet rift, breathing hard.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Look at my hands! Smooth! Young! The voice keeps its promises! A little at a time, but it keeps them!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Slug. It is lying to you. Nothing it gives is free.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Of course it isn't free! I gather fighters for him. And he swears I will live forever, like he does. He has done it once. He knows the way!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: And if you won't stand aside, I'll grow big enough to step on you!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: My hands... wrinkled again. It was never youth. It was a mask.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: He wished for it, you know. On the dragon balls, long ago. Eternal life. He looked so sad when he told me. Isn't that funny?

win.speaker: player
win.text: Who did?

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: A little prince of the Makyo, with eyes like black water. He never gave his name. He said I would know it when his star rises.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Hah! Young and strong! Go tell Hell I'm never coming back!

after.text: Slug is back in Hell, old again, and quiet. 'A prince of the Makyo who wished for eternal life.' I will tell North Kai. I think the Kais already fear the answer.

quests.title: The Word in the Deepest Pit
quests.summary: Something at the bottom of Hell has been screaming one name for days, and drinking the Malice like water.

brief.text: {name}. Something in the deepest pit of Hell is screaming one word, over and over. 'Kakarot.' The ogres no longer go near it.
It is Broly. The Malice has pooled around him like water around a stone. He has been absorbing it for days. He is still growing.
Garlic Jr.'s Mist did this?
Garlic Jr. thought he could leash the Legendary Super Saiyan. Nobody leashes that. This time I fight beside you, from start to finish.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hell, the lowest pit. The ground pulses violet. Something enormous breathes in the dark.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Kakarot... Where is Kakarot?

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: He is not here, Broly. There is only us.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Then... you will do... until he comes.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Malice swirls into Broly's chest like water down a drain. His hair flares gold, then green, then green shot through with violet.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: KAKAROTTTTT!

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: ...Kakarot...?

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The violet drains out of Broly all at once, hissing into the rock. He sits down heavily, like a child after a tantrum.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: That was the hardest fight I have had in a thousand years. And I have been dead for most of them.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: {name}. You have earned it. I will teach you, the Hyper Tornado, the Thunder Flash, all of it. Hell's champion does not say that lightly.

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: ...Hungry.

lose.speaker: enemy3
lose.text: Not Kakarot... Next...

after.text: Broly sleeps now. The ogres built a fence around him. Out of respect, they say. Out of fear, I say. Come train with me, {name}.

7.greet: Hey! I'm small again, but don't let that fool ya. Wanna learn the Dragon Fist? You gotta punch with your whole heart, not just your arm!
7.done: Wow, you got all of it! Let's grab some food, I'm starving. Then round two, okay?

8.greet: Going Super Saiyan's easier when you're little, I think. Less of you to light up! C'mon, I'll go easy at first. Kinda.
8.done: Ha! You're a natural. Pan's gonna be so jealous.

9.greet: Super Saiyan 3 eats energy like I eat dinner. You gotta burn hot without burning out. I learned that one the hard way.
9.done: That's it! Just don't stay in it too long or you'll fall asleep in the middle of a fight. Ask me how I know.

10.greet: This form came from the Great Ape, so it's all instinct. Stop thinking so much! Feel it, then hit it!
10.done: Ten times Kamehameha, huh? You're gonna be a real problem for bad guys, {name}. I love it!

20.greet: Partner! Lesson one: justice begins with the pose! Lesson two: the pose also tightens your core. It's science. Mostly.
20.done: You've mastered the way of the Great Saiyaman! Wear it with pride. And please, never let Videl see you do the third pose.

39.greet: This sword was forged in a world that ended. Learn to swing it like you mean to build something, not just cut something down.
39.done: You hold it better than I did at your age. Keep it sharp. Keep hoping. For me, those were always the same thing.

40.greet: A Super Saiyan with a blade is speed first, power second. Anger made me fast. I want you fast for better reasons.
40.done: Shining Sword Attack, perfect. Gohan would have laughed and clapped. I'm clapping for him.

41.greet: Mother says I train too much. She's right. Let's train anyway. Footwork first, Finish Buster after.
41.done: You've learned everything I can teach you in this form. I'm proud of you. Is that strange to say? I'm saying it.

42.greet: The Heat Dome Attack: you let them come to you, then you go up. Patience, then everything at once.
42.done: That's it. No fear, no lists, no shortcuts. Just strength, used well.

43.greet: This form is all muscle and no speed. I learned that against Cell. I'll teach it to you so you never make my mistake.
43.done: You've got the power, and you know its limits. That's more than I had. Good work, {name}.

44.greet: Okay, rookie, I'm teaching, so I'm the boss. First rule: if Goten says it's a good idea, it isn't.
44.done: Not bad! You're almost as cool as me. Almost. Wanna go prank Gohan?

45.greet: I went Super Saiyan before Goten did, did you know that? Bet you didn't. Watch close, I'm not doing it twice. Fine, I'll do it twice.
45.done: You can do the Big Tree Cannon now?! Don't tell my dad. He'll make me train harder.

46.greet: Hi! I'm Goten! Mom says I have to teach you nicely. I'll try! But if I get hungry we have to stop.
46.done: Yay, you learned everything! Do you have any snacks? Learning is hungry work.

47.greet: Going Super Saiyan is easy! You just... go! Like this! Hnnnngh! See? Your turn!
47.done: You're super now too! Kind of! Let's tell Trunks. He hates it when other people are good.

48.greet: Behold, the grim reaper of justice! Lesson one: be awesome. Lesson two: see lesson one.
48.done: You've learned from the greatest! No need to thank me. Okay, you can thank me a little.

49.greet: Galactic Donuts! Kamikaze ghosts! I invent a new move every five minutes. Try to keep up, rookie!
49.done: You can do the Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack! The ghosts like you. That's very rare. Probably.

50.greet: Super Saiyan 3! Look at the hair! Okay, focus. I've got less than thirty minutes before I split, so learn fast!
50.done: Charging Ultra Buu Buu Volleyball, mastered! Nobody knows what it does! Not even me! Perfect!

51.greet: Kakarot's instinct and Vegeta's precision. I'll teach you both at once, if your brain can handle it.
51.done: Well done. Kakarot wants to celebrate. Vegeta wants to pretend he isn't impressed. I'm both.

52.greet: The Final Kamehameha is a Big Bang and a Kamehameha that finally stopped arguing. Learn to make your own halves agree.
52.done: You've got it. Now go find someone stronger than you to show it to. If you can find one.

53.greet: I don't last long, and I don't waste time. Stardust Breaker. Watch, then do. No questions.
53.done: You kept up. That's rare. Don't let it go to your head. All right, a little.

54.greet: Red fur, double the pride, none of the patience. Let's see if you can survive an X100 Big Bang Kamehameha. Joking. Mostly.
54.done: Outstanding. The one with no past just matched two Saiyans' entire history. Someone write that down.

55.greet: A student! You want the secrets of the World Champion? Lesson one: when in doubt, pose. Lesson two: when in more doubt, have a stomachache.
55.done: Ha ha ha! You've learned everything! Not as well as me, of course. I let you learn. Write that down!

56.greet: No flying shortcuts in my lessons. Feet planted, fists up, and if you complain I'll tell Gohan you liked his poses.
56.done: You hit harder than half of Satan City. Good. Now go protect the other half.

57.greet: Great Saiyaman 2, reporting for training duty! Fine, I'll do the pose. But only because it actually works.
57.done: Justice approved. And you didn't laugh at the helmet once. Gohan should take notes.

61.greet: In the Otherworld, the dead train for eternity. You have less time than that. So we will train harder.
61.done: You have learned all I know. When you die, and I hope that is a long way off, come and find me. We will fight again.

62.greet: I learned the sword to guard my people and the flute to guard myself. You will learn both: one to strike, one to stay steady.
62.done: You fight with a melody now, even if you cannot hear it. Keep it. It will matter when everything else is noise.

63.greet: Okay, rookie, Pan's Training Camp is in session. No whining, no flying off, and you buy the snacks after.
63.done: Done! You learned everything, even Maiden's Rage! You're officially my second favorite fighter. After Grandpa. Both grandpas.

64.greet: Mr Goku taught me to listen to the strength inside. I'll teach you the same. Mine's a bit loud sometimes.
64.done: You learned it all. I still owe you a real fight, {name}. Maybe at the next tournament?

65.greet: Mr Buu lends me his power for this. It feels like chocolate and thunder. Let me show you how to aim it.
65.done: That's everything, {name}. Mr Buu says you're 'good good'. That's his highest grade.

100.greet: My techniques were made to destroy. I would like you to learn them to protect. Small things first. Then everything.
100.done: You have learned everything I carry. The birds approve. I checked.

101.greet: I'll teach you, but I won't hold your hand. The barrier is all timing. Get it wrong and you eat a Photon Flash.
101.done: Fine. You're good. Don't tell my sister I said so, she'd never let it go.

102.greet: I'm not doing this for free. Lesson's simple: no wasted moves. Every motion costs energy. Spend it like it's money.
102.done: That's it, you're done. I'll admit it: you were worth the time. Now get out, it's Marron's nap time.

103.greet: Lesson one. Absorb. Energy is food. Your energy smells of nothing. This makes the lesson... difficult.
103.done: Training complete. Subject... adequate. Please do not mention the gold to Android 18.

104.greet: Dr. Gero, genius of the Red Ribbon Army. I will teach you, if only to study you. Hold still while I take notes.
104.done: Remarkable. A body with no past, learning everything. I would give my other eye to open you up. Purely for science.

105.greet: Ah, the blank page. I'll teach you my early repertoire. All borrowed. Imitation is the sincerest form of absorption.
105.done: You've learned everything I stole. How poetic. Now don't stand too close. Old habits.

106.greet: This form is power without elegance. I loathe it. But it has its uses. Let us use them.
106.done: Adequate. Not perfect. Nothing is perfect at this stage. Except, eventually, me.

109.greet: Play! You want to learn? We teach by playing! Playing very, very hard!
109.done: You learned all our games! Now you're our big friend! Our biggest friend!

110.greet: Papparapa! Very well, even a Patrol brat can learn a wizard's tricks. Kneel... No? Fine, stand. Ugh.
110.done: You've learned my magic! Not that you're grateful. Nobody is ever grateful to Babidi!

111.greet: The Demon Realm teaches through pain. I've grown soft in Paradise, so I'll only use half the pain.
111.done: Good. You'd make a fine demon. That's the highest praise I know. Don't tell the angels.

115.greet: Hee! Gotenks moves taste so good. You want to learn them? Buu teaches! Buu teaches LOUD!
115.done: Done, done! You know the Gotenks tricks now. Buu is not hungry for you anymore. Probably.

116.greet: Gohan's power is so fun to wear. Hee hee. Let Buu show you how a scholar punches.
116.done: All learned! Buu is a good teacher. Better than Gohan. Don't tell Gohan.

120.greet: You will train under the greatest scientific mind on Earth. Do not touch the dome. Ever.
120.done: Fascinating. Every technique adopted perfectly. If only you'd lend me that body... A joke. A joke!

121.greet: I conquer planets for fun. Learning from me is a privilege. Here, eat this. Relax, it's just an apple.
121.done: You've got a pirate's instincts now. Take what you want, keep what you take. Just leave my tree alone.

122.greet: GRRRH. Big, stupid and strong. Sometimes that's all a fight needs. Watch the fists, not the teeth.
122.done: Hrrrrr. Good. Now go find a moon of your own.

123.greet: I was a conqueror for centuries before you were born. Listen well. Age teaches tricks youth never learns.
123.done: You learned it all, and quickly. Youth, wasted on the young. As always.

124.greet: Size is a technique, child. A Namekian who grows must learn to move as if he were still small. Watch my feet.
124.done: Good. When the day comes that you feel small, remember: small is only where you start.

125.greet: Lord Cooler's Armored Squadron trains until we bleed. I'll go easy on you. That's a lie. Draw your blade, rookie.
125.done: You've got the Salza Blade Rush. Use it well. And keep watching the pipes for me.

126.greet: I'll teach you, if only to prove I'm a better teacher than my brother. Frieza never taught anyone anything.
126.done: You've learned my style. Wear it with arrogance. That's the only way it fits.

127.greet: A form my brother never reached. Don't fear the mask. Fear what's underneath it.
127.done: Supernova, mastered. Use it on Frieza if you ever get the chance. I'll pay.

128.greet: Learning protocol initiated. Each technique will be repeated until you are perfect, or broken.
128.done: Protocol complete. Subject has exceeded projected parameters. That is... annoying.

129.greet: Howdy, partner. Gero gave me a fondness for the old West and a hatred for Goku. Only one of 'em stuck.
129.done: Yeehaw, you got all of it! Go on, ride off into the sunset. Or the glacier. Whichever's closer.

130.greet: With 14 and 15's chips in me, I hit like a freight train. Lesson one: don't stand in front of the freight train.
130.done: Done and dusted. The S.S. Deadly Hammer's yours now. Use it wisely, partner. Or at least loudly.

131.done: ...Good. You are... strong. Not Kakarot. But strong.

132.greet: Rrrgh. Power. It never stops. I will show you how to hold it. Do not let go.
132.done: You held it. Most people break.

133.greet: I am the Legendary Super Saiyan. There is no technique. There is only more. Learn more.
133.done: ...You survived all of it. Kakarot will be... interested.

134.greet: Training with me? Sure, sweetie. Psycho Thread first. It's all in the wrists. Try not to tie yourself up.
134.done: Look at you, all grown up. Now go break some hearts. Or some Kais. Either's fine.

135.greet: I learned to fight by conquering. You'll learn by bleeding. Show me how long you last.
135.done: Hah. You'd have made a fine Galaxy Soldier. Shame you're on the Kais' leash.

136.greet: Full power. No holding back. This is what the Kais were afraid of. Let's see if you're afraid too.
136.done: Galactic Buster, mastered. Now when the Kais seal you away, you'll have something to practice.

139.greet: (Hildegarn's huge eyes follow you. When you raise your fists, it raises its claws. The lesson has begun.)
139.done: (Hildegarn lowers its head, almost gently, and lets out a long, satisfied rumble.)

140.greet: The Tuffle mind is superior. I will teach you through this Saiyan body, which is the cruelest joke I know.
140.done: You learned all of it. The Tuffles would have been proud to own a mind like yours.

141.greet: Stronger, sharper, Tuffle-perfect. Watch the Finger Blitz Barrage. Count the shots, if you can.
141.done: You counted every one. Irritatingly impressive.

142.greet: With a whole planet's energy behind me, I will teach you the Revenge Death Ball. Revenge is an excellent teacher.
142.done: Revenge suits you. No? Pity. Then power suits you.

143.greet: GOLDEN... APE... I will teach you... the GRUDGE... of the Tuffles!
143.done: Hrrrr... good... the moon... remembers you now.

144.greet: Two 17s, one body. My barrier stops anything. I'll show you how. Don't make my sister come down here.
144.done: Hell's Storm, mastered. You could probably beat me now. Don't.

145.greet: I am Nuova Shenron of the Four-Star Ball. I fight with honor and with fire. Show me yours.
145.done: You have learned it all with grace. I hope you never need my fire to burn anything you love.

146.greet: I am every selfish wish ever made. I teach you because it amuses me. Do not mistake that for mercy.
146.done: Mastered. How tiresome. Leave, before I change my mind about you.

147.greet: I am minus energy given form. Learn from despair, little Patrol. It is a very patient teacher.
147.done: You survived all of it. Even despair. The dragon balls have never seen anything like you.

158.greet: I remember being someone's puppet. Now I'll teach you how to get back up. Just... no jokes about my neck.
158.done: You learned it. You're tougher than me. And a lot less embarrassing. Go on.

159.greet: Trunks says you've been looking after him. Thank you. The Kais let a little of my echo stay. Long enough to teach you. Masenko first.
159.done: You learned it all. I'm proud of you, {name}. Look after the future. Both of them.

160.greet: This is how I fought for years, with one arm. Don't feel sorry for me. Watch the balance. You learn to make every strike count.
160.done: You make every strike count now. That's all a teacher can hope for.
